name: recall
title: Calibration recall desk
subtitle: Recorded dates and eligibility, as of database current date

sections.title: Due in the next 30 days or overdue
sections.sql: select site,code,name,owner,coalesce(next_due::text,'unknown') as next_due,coalesce(days_to_due::text,'unknown') as days_to_due,eligibility from v_recall order by next_due nulls first,code

sections.title: Site readiness
sections.sql: select * from v_sites order by site

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.note: Checks references and recorded dates only. An operator inspects the underlying documents.
sections.sql: select site,code,performed_on,gaps from v_evidence where gaps<>'' order by site,code

sections.title: Known batches since the prior verified pass
sections.note: The scope includes use after the failure. Missing use records are not proof of no impact.
sections.sql: select code,owner,status,due_on,batch,used_on,quantity,scope from v_impact order by code,used_on
